speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: asked the Minister for National Development since 2016 (a) whether there has been an increase in the number of BTO flat owners asking to delay the collection of keys or for a waiver of payment of holding interest because of difficulties in selling their existing property and, if so, what is the increase; (b) how many of such owners have had to cancel their BTO flats and forfeit deposits despite HDB exercising flexibility; and (c) what are the top reasons for those whom HDB have been unable to assist in such situations.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: For these buyers, HDB already exercises flexibility and grant a reasonable time extension.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Flat buyers are advised to exercise prudence in their flat purchase.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: If they plan to finance the new flat purchase with the sales proceeds from their existing flat, they should take into account possible changes in market conditions which may affect their plans and be realistic in their asking prices.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: In addition, they can make use of HDB's regular updates on the Probable Completion Date of their new flats to plan the sale of their existing flat.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
text: I just want to clarify whether 2% of the total number of flat applications is against the total number or is it just those who purchase from a resale flat before.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
text: A number of cases I have come across were that they were all caught because of the slow resale market right now.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
text: Some have difficulty paying the cash that they have to top up.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
text: Is there a possibility for HDB to exercise more leniency because I understand that sometimes the holding costs are quite high, at a few hundred dollars?

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
text: At the same time, can we also protect buyers through better credit modelling, knowing that the market could tank after a certain period because BTO flats do take some time to complete?

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: So, that is to clarify on the statistics.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: For the most part, most of them are able to sell their flats and then complete their new flat purchase transaction, but there is that minority who chose not to.
